spec.title: Last Ingested Record Time
spec.description:
The last ingested record time for each store.

Note that the last ingested record time metric only updates when the store ingests a new transaction so if no transaction is ingested the last ingested time will not advance. For a party performing reward collection, e.g., the validator operator party you expect at least one transaction every round so the last ingested time should be at most 20min ago.

spec.title: Ingestion rate txlog entries
spec.description: How many txlog entries were ingested per $rate_interval

spec.title: Ingestion rate events
spec.description: How many events (created / archived) were ingested per $rate_interval

spec.title: Last Ingested Record Time Lag
spec.description:
The time difference between the last ingested record time and the current wallclock time.

Note that the last ingested record time metric only updates when the store ingests a new transaction so if there is no activity, the last ingested record time will not advance. For a party performing reward collection, e.g., the validator operator party you expect at least one transaction every round so the lag should not go above 20min.

spec.title: Last Seen Record Time Lag
spec.description:
The time difference between the last seen record time and the current wallclock time.

The last seen record time updates regardless of whether an update was ingested or filtered out.

spec.title: Last Seen Record Time
spec.description:
The most recent record time seen by this store for each synchronizer in milliseconds.

This updates for every entry seen, regardless of whether it was ingested or filtered out.

spec.name: store_party
spec.description: The party that the store is ingesting data for
